title: Rehearse client briefing and personal-assistant review through existing tools
summary: StateCivics-owned connected rehearsal: reuse client research and activation forms, the existing personal assistant/MCP wizard and no-login timeline to investigate a Matter trigger, decide whether to report or stay quiet, retain scoped findings and feed the next JEV decision. This Matter-roadmap record does not create a KS ticket, authorize host implementation or approve production use.
in_scope: Reuse KS-1135 client relation research and KS-1123 reviewed activation; add a cited draft briefing and keep/edit/add/reject flow without duplicate profile infrastructure.
Reuse KS-705 exact assessment/evidence reads and existing wizard/session/tool registry; connect only confirmed missing assistant wake-up, review persistence and isolated outcome mapping.
Capture-only end-to-end evidence with two contrasting organizations/objectives, historical context, quiet findings and a later material development.
out_of_scope: Implementation, provider/tool execution, client-data processing or deployment as part of this planning commit.
New assistant/model client, MCP server, tool wizard, source index, database, queue or general orchestration framework where existing owners supply the capability.
Changing frozen monitoring 1.0/1.1 semantics silently; production alerts, formal qualification, DIAT or unrelated Oil work.
implementation: Before implementation, reconcile this roadmap with KS-1135, KS-705, KS-1123/1124/1125/1126 and KS-1145 in the StateCivics workflow. Pin existing WizardDispatchMixin, wizard_engine ToolExposure/session and workflow_registry/read contracts; locate the actual user-assistant runtime rather than building a replacement.

Use existing lobbyist/represented-organization records and authorized historical mentions as realistic sample audiences. Record actual identities, aliases and dated representation separately from invented example objectives; never call them StateCivics customers or infer current stance from representation alone.

Reuse the relation-profile work for a cited initial briefing: who said/wrote what, dated past involvement, active issues, uncertainty and suggested monitoring angles. User keeps/edits/adds/rejects, reviews the summary and explicitly activates versioned intent through the existing forms. Previously approved objectives can exercise assistant review before this bootstrap enhancement is complete.

Use the same authorized evidence and timeline for contrasting clients. Retrieval/indexed candidate discovery and topic/keyword/place packets are owned by KS-1145; verify its current implementation before claiming a remaining gap. An already supported bill-version path can supply a first run without requiring every source family.

Connect one bounded read-only assistant investigation pass through actual permitted MCP/wizard tools. Keep internal review requests/notes separate from human-visible AlertDelivery and communicated baselines; store proposed reports/alerts only in isolated capture sinks. No automatic MCP writes, messages, delivery or tool calls outside the user grant set.

Retain the quiet finding with citations and angle, then show a later meaningful change producing a different justified proposal. Test relevant material without literal keyword matches, irrelevant keyword hits, duplicate silence, linked correction/new deadline, missing source, source ambiguity, in-flight edits/revocation and source-availability cuts.

Record scenario authoring, synthetic/recorded conformance, actual assistant/MCP runtime, live JEV interpretation and formal qualification as different evidence. Freeze model/tools, explicit budgets and intended outcomes before any later authorized live exploratory run; do not claim live execution from injected responses.

acceptance.criterion: Existing client and tool infrastructure is reused with reviewed context.
acceptance.verification: Name the actual host APIs and KS owners, show a cited draft briefing and keep/edit/reject activation, and verify unrelated notes/contacts are excluded unless separately authorized. Real representation facts remain distinct from illustrative interests.

acceptance.criterion: A connected quiet-then-material-change sequence uses the actual assistant/tool path.
acceptance.verification: Run the no-login rehearsal with two approved objectives, one bounded investigation pass, a saved quiet finding and subsequent re-evaluation. Retain exact tool/model requests/responses and isolated captures; authored expectations or mock probabilities alone cannot establish the connected runtime.

acceptance.criterion: Client isolation, chronology and communication baselines survive the full handoff.
acceptance.verification: Check foreign client/angle refusal, future-evidence exclusion, currentness after edit/revoke, duplicates, actual corrections/deadlines and unknown outcomes. Internal wake-up, reviewed evidence and unshown history must not become delivered/read/handled knowledge.

acceptance.criterion: Exploratory acceptance does not imply production qualification or deployment.
acceptance.verification: Publish exact host/SDK/runtime/image/tool/source pins and passed/failed/unrun outcomes; keep MAT-040/042/050 and production activation separate. No missing independent labels block the capture-only test by themselves.

tests: Two contrasting approved objectives see the same source facts and can yield different quiet/report decisions.
Historical search alone is not delivery or user acknowledgement.
New information can overturn the earlier quiet finding without relying on a copied model assumption.
risks: Historical mentions and third-party claims can be mistaken for the client current position.
Silent profile updates, future-source leakage or a default human alert can make an apparently useful demo unsafe or misleading.

reuse.application: Reuse relation-profile research and actual approval forms; do not invent a second client profile store.
Reuse existing sessions, tool exposure and exact-evidence readers; a tool list alone is not proof of the missing assessment read or background wake-up contract.
Reuse captured dispatch, review/feedback and replay stack; host owns all implementation and local ticket reconciliation.

sources: Owner discussion, 2026-10-31: client onboarding research; bubble burst wakes the user-specific assistant; bounded existing MCP/wizard investigation; report/alert judgment; quiet findings retained per user/client/angle for cascading JEV. Ticket writing only; unresolved choices remain proposals.
